people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: “How Sheshach is taken! How the praise of the whole earth seized! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!
translations.bsb: How Sheshach has been captured! The praise of all the earth has been seized. What a horror Babylon has become among the nations!
translations.kjv: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!
